Accept Public Improvements and Exonerate Maintenance Bond
items.description: Maintenance bond exoneration for street improvements associated with Cherry Ave from Oak Valley Parkway to Cougar Way (Sundance) and Traffic Signal improvements associated with Parcel Map No. 36426.
items.recommendation: Accept the public improvements, authorize the Mayor to sign the Certificate of Acceptance, and authorize staff to issue a bond exoneration letter for maintenance bonds for (Project / Bond Number / Improvement): Cherry Ave from Oak Valley to Cougar Way (Sundance) / 929598708-M / Street Parcel Map No. 36426 / 107736393 / Traffic Signal

items.title: FY 2024 Popular Annual Financial Report
items.description: Receive and file the City’s Fiscal Year End 2024 Popular Annual Financial Report.
items.recommendation: Receive and file the City’s Fiscal Year End 2024 Popular Annual Financial Report.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2024 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report and Report of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting
items.description: Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Audit and Results
items.recommendation: Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2024 Annual Comprehensive Report and associated reports.

items.title: FY 2025-2026 Budget Timeline
items.description: Review and provide direction on proposed FY 2025-2026 budget timeline.

items.title: Proposed Ordinance to Update Participation in the TUMF Program; Resolution Adopting A TUMF Schedule
items.description: Ordinance and Resolution to adopt the 2024 Nexus Study and Fee Schedule for TUMF.
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; Waive the full reading and approve by title only, “An Ordinance of the City of Beaumont Amending and Superseding Ordinance No. 1091 to Update Participation in the Western Riverside County Transportation Uniform Mitigation Fee (TUMF) Program”; and, Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Amending the Applicable Transportation Uniform Mitigation Fee (TUMF) Applicable to all Developments in the City of Beaumont.”

items.title: Consideration of PLAN2024-0130 for an Automobile for Hire Operation Permit for an ambulance service at 875 West Fourth Street located within the City of Beaumont
items.description: A request to operate an Automobile for Hire operation for Advantage Ambulance, Inc. located at 875 West Fourth Street in the City of Beaumont.
items.recommendation: Hold a Public Hearing Approve the PLAN2024-1030 Auto for Hire Application for Advantage Ambulance, Inc. to operate in the City of Beaumont.

items.title: Continuation of a Public Hearing of Request to Appeal Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement
items.description: Tri Pointe Homes has requested an appeal of the City Manager’s Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement dated August 17, 2004.
items.recommendation: Continue the Request to Appeal Notice of Finding Under Development Agreement dated August 17, 2004, to the City Council Meeting of January 21, 2025.

items.title: Appointments to City Commission, Committees and Board
items.description: Appointments to Planning Commission, Financial and Audit Committee, Economic Development Committee and Board of Administrative Appeals.
items.recommendation: Conduct interviews followed by the selection process outlined in BMC 2.04.100

items.title: Relocation and Replacement of the Welcome to Beaumont Electronic Billboard Sign Located at 1691 East Sixth Street (APN: 419-180-025) in the Local Commercial (LC) Zone
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; and Approve PLAN2024-0108 relocation and replacement of the Welcome to Beaumont Electronic Billboard.

items.title: Award Professional Services Agreements with IMEG to Provide Facility Condition Assessments for 500 Grace Avenue and 105 Sixth Street – Capital Improvement Project CD-03
items.description: Award contracts for a term of one year to IMEG to provide facility condition assessments for 500 Grace Avenue and 105 Sixth Street.
items.recommendation: Award Professional Services Agreements with IMEG for a term of one year to provide facility conditions assessments for 500 Grace Avenue and 105 Sixth Street at the fixed rates in the attached proposals.

items.title: Award a Professional Services Agreement to SKM Engineering LLC for SCADA Programming and System Integration Services for Wastewater Facilities
items.description: SCADA programming and system integration services for Wastewater Facilities.
items.recommendation: Award a Professional Services Agreement to SKM Engineering LLC for SCADA programming and system integration for wastewater facilities in an amount not to exceed $75,000.

items.title: Riverside County Superintendent of Schools Special Education Vocational Education Program
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement with Riverside County Superintendent of School and Riverside County Office of Education.

items.title: Approval of Grant Agreement for the Second Street Extension
items.description: City Council approval is requested for the FY 2024 Community Project Funding (CPF) Grant Agreement between the City of Beaumont and the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). This agreement provides $1,000,000 in federal funding to support the Second Street Extension Project.
items.recommendation: Approve Grant Agreement No. B-24-CP-CA-0317 and authorize the City Manager, or their designee, to execute the agreement and related documentation necessary to implement the grant.

items.title: Right-of-way Acceptance for Veile Avenue
items.description: A resolution of the City of Beaumont accepting right-of-way for Veile Avenue as part of the conditions of approval for Hidden Canyon Industrial Park, Parcel Map No. 36426 (Project).
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Accepting Right-of-Way for Veile Avenue”.

items.recommendation: Discuss and appoint Council Members to each board, commission and committee.
